messages:
gina: Quick note 44E2 	6; we're publishing redwood-js-sdk v0.5.0 docs and deprecating the legacy callback stream API. PR with migration guide: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/689

ryan: Short summary for support engineers?

gina: Old callback style `client.on('data', cb)` is deprecated. New API is async-iteration/promise-first. Compatibility shim included for ~45 days. Example migration snippet in the guide:
```js
// old (callback)
client.on('data', chunk => console.log(chunk))
client.on('end', () => console.log('done'))

// new (async iterator)
for await (const chunk of client.stream(prompt)) {
  console.log(chunk)
}
```

hannah: Node version impact? Build pipelines?

gina: Minimum Node bumped to 14.17.0 due to async iterator usage. CI check will warn on older engines. No env var changes.

releasebot: release published: redwood-js-sdk 0.5.0 on npm 389 https://www.npmjs.com/package/redwood-js-sdk/v/0.5.0

docs-bot: Docs site updated: /js-sdk/streams-migration. CDN cache purge scheduled for 12:30 UTC. Redirects added for old callback docs.

gina: Action items: @hannah publish KB with top 3 errors (missing async runtime, event handlers left registered, import path changes); @ryan pin migration note in community and schedule an office hours drop-in next Tue 15:00 UTC. We'll monitor support for two weeks. Thanks! :rocket:
